from slugify import slugify
cases = [
    ('Crème Brûlée', '-', 'creme-brulee'),
    ('Ñandú', '-', 'nandu'),
    ('Hello World', '-', 'hello-world'),
    ('a -- b!!c', '-', 'a-b-c'),
    ('Hello World', '_', 'hello_world'),
]
for text, sep, want in cases:
    got = slugify(text, sep=sep)
    assert got == want, f'{text!r}: got {got!r}, want {want!r}'
print('all pass')
